findings.title: 4 box(es) use a class id that does not exist
findings.detail: An id at or above nc indexes past the model's classification head. Ultralytics raises on this during dataset verification; a hand-rolled loader will index out of bounds mid-epoch.
evidence: train/000000436883 line 4: class id 13 but data.yaml defines 12 classes (0..11)
train/000000492362 line 5: class id 15 but data.yaml defines 12 classes (0..11)
val/000000297084 line 4: class id 13 but data.yaml defines 12 classes (0..11)
val/000000536947 line 1: class id 15 but data.yaml defines 12 classes (0..11)

findings.title: 3 label row(s) are not parseable
findings.detail: A YOLO row must be `class_id xc yc w h`. Rows that are not will raise during dataset scanning or be skipped silently depending on the loader version.
